name: Simple navigation
summary: Brand, three to five links, and one action. Links collapse into a native disclosure menu on phones.
accessibility: The <nav> has aria-label="Main" so it is distinguishable from other navigation landmarks.
The phone menu is a native <details> element: Enter and Space toggle it, and it works without JavaScript.
Every link and the menu toggle show a focus outline in the focus color.

states.name: hover
states.description: Links darken from muted to ink; the action button drops to 90% opacity.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A 2px outline in the focus color, offset by 2px.

states.name: menu open
states.description: Below md, the Menu disclosure opens a panel with the links and the action.
